title: PSPACE-hardness of vertex cover reconfiguration with one temporary extra vertex

difficulty_reason: After the explicit Reconfiguration 3SAT hardness input and the familiar static SAT-to-VC gadgets, the author still constructs a global path lift: serial clause exchanges before/after a variable flip maintain every intermediate cover using only one temporary extra vertex. The reverse projection of base-size covers forces satisfying assignments differing in at most one variable. This coupled reconfiguration and tight-budget invariant is the nonroutine H2 burden.
statement_scope: Given G, k, and two covers of size k, reachability by one-vertex additions/removals through covers of size k or k+1 is PSPACE-hard. No PSPACE-membership or completeness claim is added. Count the explicit first-stage intermediate claim once. The graph is arbitrary; no proper-3CNF hypothesis is imposed on the target. The later cycle-removing reduction is outside the statement and proof.
